task_completion.description: Create partition walls and define four functional rooms named 'Control Room', 'Green Room', 'Makeup', and 'Studio Floor'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for partition walls in the 2D floor plan and text labels or room objects explicitly named 'Control Room', 'Green Room', 'Makeup', and 'Studio Floor'.

task_completion.description: Furnish the Studio Floor with an anchor desk setup (1+ desk, 2+ chairs) and studio grid lighting (4+ fixtures).
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the 'Studio Floor' area, identify a desk with at least two chairs facing it, and at least four light fixture models (often represented as spotlights or overhead lamps) in the 3D view or furniture list.

task_completion.description: The Control Room must include a master control console with at least three desks and six screens.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the 'Control Room', count at least three desk/table items and at least six monitor/screen items in the furniture list or 3D view.

task_completion.description: At least four monitors in the Control Room must be wall-mounted at an elevation of 80 cm or higher.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Check the furniture property dialogs or the 3D view for monitors attached to walls. Verify the 'Elevation' or 'Height' attribute is set to 80 cm or more for at least four screens.

task_completion.description: Furnish Talent Prep Areas (Green Room/Makeup) with at least one sofa and one sink.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for a sofa/couch model and a sink/washbasin model placed within the designated Green Room or Makeup room boundaries.

task_completion.description: Use a minimum of 40 items from the catalog across the facility and save the project.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Check the furniture list pane on the left; it should contain at least 40 entries. Look for the 'Save' action in the menu or a 'Project saved' message in the status bar.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the Sweet Home 3D GUI rather than using scripts or terminal commands to generate the file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor moving, furniture being dragged from the catalog, and dialog boxes being filled out manually.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply open a pre-made template but started from the provided shell.
integrity.visual_evidence: Early screenshots should show the empty 'tv_studio_starter.sh3d' shell before furniture and walls are added.

integrity.description: Room names were manually entered to match the specific requirements.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Modify room' dialog box should be visible with the specific names ('Control Room', etc.) being typed in.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task starts with a file named 'tv_studio_starter.sh3d' which is a shell with no furniture. The agent must reach a total of 100 points based on: 4 specific room names, an anchor desk (1 desk/2 chairs), 4 studio lights, a control console (3 desks/6 screens), 4 wall-mounted monitors at elevation >= 80cm, 1 sofa, 1 sink, and a total furniture count of at least 40 items. The pass threshold is 70 points.
